grammar_tips.title: Using 'going to' for intentions and plans
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'am/is/are going to + base verb' for plans decided before speaking: I am going to visit my aunt.

explanation_translation.Hindi: पहले से तय योजनाओं के लिए 'am/is/are going to + क्रिया' का प्रयोग करें: I am going to visit my aunt.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 発話前に決めた計画は『am/is/are going to + 動詞原形』: I am going to visit my aunt.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'will' for quick decisions and predictions
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'will + base verb' for decisions made now or predictions: I will help you. It will rain.

explanation_translation.Hindi: अभी लिए गए निर्णय और भविष्यवाणी के लिए 'will + क्रिया' प्रयोग करें: I will help you. It will rain.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 今の決定や予想は『will + 動詞原形』: I will help you. It will rain.

grammar_tips.title: Forming questions about the future
grammar_tips.explanation: Plans: Are you going to…? Predictions/requests: Will you…? Example: Are you going to study? Will you come?

explanation_translation.Hindi: योजनाएँ: Are you going to…? भविष्यवाणी/अनुरोध: Will you…? उदाहरण: Are you going to study? Will you come?
explanation_translation.Japanese: 計画: Are you going to…? 予想/依頼: Will you…? 例: Are you going to study? Will you come?

grammar_tips.title: Time expressions for the future
grammar_tips.explanation: Use tomorrow, next week, in June, later, soon with future forms.

explanation_translation.Hindi: Future के साथ tomorrow, next week, in June, later, soon जैसे समय-वाचक शब्द प्रयोग करें।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 未来を表す語（tomorrow, next week, in June, later, soon）を一緒に使います。
